raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience FIS Global | Pune India Service Delivery Manager | Senior Scrum Master July 2023 – July 2026 Business Overview Led Agile delivery for the Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) program supporting enterprise Banking, Capital Markets, and Investment Accounting platforms. The program focused on modernizing investment accounting capabilities by replacing third-party cost basis and amortization processing with the FIS InvestOne platform. Partnered with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Architects, Development, QA, and Data Engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and business-critical solutions while improving operational efficiency, reducing vendor dependency. Key Responsibilities

Lead Agile delivery across multiple Banking, Capital Markets, Loan Accounting, and InvestOne product teams, driving sprint execution, release planning, delivery governance, and cross-functional collaboration.
Partner with Product Owners, Business Product Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, refine product backlogs, and align delivery with business objectives. Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, manage dependencies, remove impediments, and ensure predictable sprint execution and release readiness.

• Drive delivery governance through capacity planning, sprint forecasting, risk mitigation, dependency
management, and continuous delivery improvements.
• Coach Agile teams on Scrum, Kanban, and Agile best practices while fostering team collaboration, Agile

maturity, and continuous improvement. Leverage Agile metrics including Velocity, Sprint Predictability, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput, Burndown, and WIP to enable data-driven decision-making and transparent stakeholder reporting.
★ Key Projects
Project 1: Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) Enhancement
Modernized the Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) platform by replacing a third-party vendor solution with the FIS InvestOne platform for cost basis and amortization processing. The solution reduced vendor dependency, lowered licensing costs, improved operational efficiency, and strengthened investment accounting capabilities across the Capital Markets ecosystem.
. Project 2: CBRS Transfer-In Asset Processing Platform
This project supports the transfer of investment holdings between brokerage firms. When an investor transfers securities from one broker to another, transfer details are received through the DTCC network. The platform processes the incoming transfer data, creates tax lots for the transferred securities, and maintains accurate cost basis information for tax reporting and regulatory compliance. The solution helps brokerage firms efficiently manage account transfers while ensuring accurate investment records.
Products & Platforms
Loan Accounting • Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) • CBRS Transfer-In Platform • InvestOne (IAM) • Capital Markets • Investment Accounting
Exela Technology| Pune India Project Leader and Scrum Master– Data Science Team May 2022 – July 2023 Business Overview Led Agile delivery for enterprise Data Science, Data Engineering, and Document Management initiatives focused on modernizing business-critical applications and migrating enterprise documents to the Microsoft Azure platform. Partnered with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions through Agile and Scrum practice Key Responsibilities

Facilitated Scrum events and managed sprint delivery for multiple Agile teams, ensuring smooth execution of processes.
Collaborated closely with Product Owners for backlog refinement and prioritization aligned with product goals.
Managed Jira boards, dashboards, workflows, and project reporting.
★ Key Projects Enterprise Data Migration & Cloud Modernization

Successfully led Agile delivery for a large-scale document migration initiative involving over 20,000 legal documents from Microsoft OneDrive to Microsoft Azure.
Coordinated cross-functional teams to deliver OCR-based document classification, duplicate detection,

Azure Cognitive Search integration, and secure role-based document access. Improved delivery predictability, stakeholder collaboration, and release readiness through effective sprint planning, dependency management, and continuous Agile improvements.
AJ TECHSOFT | Pune, India Scrum Master Feb 2019 – May 2022 Business Overview Led Agile delivery for enterprise Healthcare applications, collaborating with Product Owners, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable patient care solutions. Facilitated Agile adoption while driving sprint execution, release planning, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement across cross-functional Scrum teams.
Key Responsibilities


Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning to improve delivery predictability and cross-functional collaboration. Implemented Agile metrics, sprint reporting, and capacity planning to improve delivery transparency and team performance.
AJ TECHSOFT | Pune, India Quality Analyst Nov 2012 – Jan 2019 Key Responsibilities
Executed manual functional, regression, integration, and system testing for enterprise applications. • Designed and executed test cases, identified defects, and collaborated with developers to ensure timely

issue resolution. Logged, tracked, and validated defects using defect management tools while participating in defect triage meetings.
